children: Clean Harbors priced a $600 million private offering of 6.250% senior notes due 2034 to fund acquisitions and repay revolver borrowings.
Commenced and priced a $600 million private offering of senior notes due 2034, sold to qualified institutional buyers and under Regulation S.
Notes carry a 6.250% interest rate and were priced at 100% of principal; expected to close on or about October 1, 2026.
Net proceeds intended to finance the EnviroServe acquisition and repay revolver borrowings used for the ES&H acquisition.
Offering is not contingent on completion of the acquisitions; if an acquisition does not close, proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
